in_marathi.name: Giriraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Giriraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Giriraj means the one who rules over the mountains. It is derived from two Sanskrit words 'Giri' which means mountain and 'Raja' which means king. The name is often given to a boy who is believed to have the strength and power of a mountain king.

vedic_reference.note: The name 'Giriraj' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Giri', meaning mountain, and 'Raj', meaning king or ruler. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is often referred to as Giriraj, as he is believed to reside on the mountain Kailash.
